csv_scope_of_work: The City of Athens intends to engage a qualified firm for professional engineering services for a full range of aviation needs at the Athens Municipal Airport (F44). Utilizing multiple engineering/design and construction grants over the course of the next five years, future scope of work items at the Athens Municipal Airport (F44) may include the following: Land Acquisition Surveying Project Cost Estimating Runway Design and Construction Access Roadway Design and Construction Access Taxiway and Taxi-lane Design and Construction Rehabilitation/Reconstruction of Existing Pavement Fuel Tanks/Fuel Farm Systems Hangar Development Terminal Renovations, Construction or Expansion Drainage Improvements Airport Perimeter Fencing and Access Gates Electrical System Design and Upgrades Improvements to the Automated Weather Observing System (AWOS) Other Services Requiring a Professional Engineer
csv_disciplines_requested: Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Cost Estimating, Electrical Engineering, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering

title: Engineering Services for Athens Municipal Airport (F44)
short_description: Multi-year airport engineering services for airside, landside, utility, and building improvements.
project_scope: Professional engineering services for a full range of aviation-related projects at Athens Municipal Airport (F44) over the next five years. Potential tasks include land acquisition, surveying, cost estimating, runway design and construction, access roadway design and construction, access taxiway and taxilane design and construction, rehabilitation or reconstruction of existing pavement, fuel tank and fuel farm systems, hangar development, terminal renovation/construction/expansion, drainage improvements, perimeter fencing and access gates, electrical system upgrades, and AWOS improvements.
services: Professional engineering services including civil engineering, rehabilitation and refurbishment, surveying/GIS/mapping, cost estimating, electrical engineering, stormwater engineering, and traffic design engineering for airport-related planning, design, and construction support.
relevance_explanation:
- Multi-disciplinary airport engineering framework for various future tasks, not a clearly defined single structural project.
- Includes potential hangar and terminal works, which could involve building structures, but no concrete size, span, or structural complexity is stated.
- Main focus appears to be general civil/aviation infrastructure such as runways, pavements, roads, drainage, fencing, and utilities.
- Limited direct fit with sbp core strengths in bridges, long-span roofs, special structures, and architecturally demanding structural design.
- Could offer occasional building or special-structure components, but current notice is too broad and unspecific.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The notice describes a five-year program with multiple future grants and possible tasks including runway works, taxiways, hangars, terminal renovations/expansion, drainage, fencing, fuel systems, and electrical upgrades. Because the scope is indefinite and covers multiple potential projects, no realistic single construction cost estimate can be derived from the provided information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the source. The procurement is for on-call/professional engineering services over five years for multiple possible airport projects, so a realistic sbp fee cannot be determined from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified firm for professional engineering services covering a full range of aviation needs at a municipal airport; requested disciplines include rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, cost estimating, electrical engineering, stormwater, and traffic design engineering.

notes: RFP/RFQ stage. Contract duration: 60 months. Not renewable. Questions deadline: 2026-06-08 05:00 PM CDT. The notice is a broad airport engineering services procurement rather than a clearly defined single project. Category selected as Buildings because hangar development and terminal renovation/construction are included, although much of the scope is civil airside infrastructure.
